business_summary: Digital Information Technologies Corporation operates as an information services company. The company focuses on custom development for end-users and information systems in a wide range of fields, including finance, medical/pharmaceutical, communications, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, and public works. Its products include WebARGUS, a website security solution; xoBlos, a platform for Excel, which automates inefficient Excel-based tasks; Anti Phishing Mail Gateway, an electronic signature gateway solution automatically converts regular email to electronic signature email, as well as counters the phishing emails; shield cms, a website creation platform; Phants, a pharmacy chain management system; and DD-CONNECT, an outsourcing service for electronic contracts. The company also develops custom software for in-vehicle devices, mobile devices, information home appliances, and communication equipment; and offers verification services, including various laboratory tests. In addition. It sells Data Migration Box, a cloud migration tool; DiskDeleter, a proprietary USB memory-type data-deletion software. Digital Information Technologies Corporation was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
